target_audience: Water distribution companies, route managers, delivery drivers, and administrative staff
emotional_tone: Professional, reliable, crisp, precision-oriented, and efficient

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-800/50

components_strategy.charts: Recharts for financial, inventory, and delivery analytics
components_strategy.state_management: React useState, Context API, and LocalStorage persistence for demo

key_modules: Admin Dashboard: Real-time KPIs, Revenue vs Expenses, Fleet status, Stock alerts
Product & Inventory Management: SKU management, minimum stock thresholds, returnable bottle tracking (Galões 20L)
Customer & Order Management: Customer database, delivery addresses, order placement
Delivery & Route Control: Route builder, stop sequencing, driver assignment, real-time status (Pending, In Transit, Delivered, Failed, Damaged Bottle)
Driver Operational Portal: Mobile-optimized view for delivery staff to execute routes, update statuses, and log collections/damages
Financial & Expense Control: Driver daily cash/pix collections, expense logging, admin approval workflow with net reconciliation

image_urls.description: Water distribution truck loaded with bottles

universal_guidelines: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute.
NO transparent backgrounds on headers or sticky elements without backdrop blur.
Responsive mobile-first layout with generous padding (p-6 to p-8).
All forms use validated inputs, toast notifications via Sonner, and clean states.
